biocontainers.name: bioconductor-gpa
biocontainers.summary: GPA (Genetic analysis incorporating Pleiotropy and Annotation)

biotools.summary: This package provides functions for fitting GPA, a statistical framework to prioritize GWAS results by integrating pleiotropy information and annotation data. In addition, it also includes ShinyGPA, an interactive visualization toolkit to investigate pleiotropic architecture.
